game.title: Sonic Generations
game.blurb: Platformer from SEGA, Sonic Team and Devil's Details, published by SEGA, released 2011-11-01. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Arcade, Family, Platformer. Chapters follow the nine stages named in the Steam achievements, in the same order as StrategyWiki's contents page, plus chapters drawn from achievement themes.

chapters.title: Green Hill, Chemical Plant and Sky Sanctuary
chapters.summary: The first three stages, their stage feats, and the boss and rival achievements with API names for Metal Sonic and the Death Egg. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Speed Highway, City Escape and Seaside Hill
chapters.summary: The middle three stages, their stage feats, and the achievements with API names for Shadow and Perfect Chaos. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Crisis City, Rooftop Run and Planet Wisp
chapters.summary: The last three stages, their stage feats, the Silver and Dragoon fights, the final boss, the emeralds and clearing the game. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: S Ranks, Time Attack and Rankings
chapters.summary: S ranks from one act to all of them, Time Attack on every stage, the rankings and the 30 Second Trial.

chapters.title: Challenges, Missions and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Friends' Challenges and chats, half and all missions, Red Star Rings, custom skills and every collectible.

chapters.title: Tricks and Actions
chapters.summary: Trick combos, defeating 100 enemies and performing all of Sonic's actions.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 71340)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Sonic_Generations
Fandom (sonic.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://sonic.fandom.com/wiki/Sonic_Generations
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4331); RAWG keeps "Sonic X Shadow Generations" (2024) separately. The Steam store list has app 71340, titled "Sonic Generations Collection" (the only match for this title); its schema is named "ValveTestApp71340" (a placeholder name) and has 49 achievements, 24 hidden. SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS is a separate app (2513280) and was not used. StrategyWiki has "Sonic Generations" at completion stage 2, but only Controls, Achievements and trophies, Metal Sonic, Shadow the Hedgehog, Silver the Hedgehog and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay, Walkthrough, all 18 act pages and the Death Egg Robot, Perfect Chaos, Egg Dragoon and Time Eater pages are linked but not written, so there was no walkthrough to use. Its contents page also carries a Sonic X Shadow Generations section. The order of its stages matches the Steam list (ClearGHZ to ClearPLA). sonic.fandom.com answers the API under "Sonic Generations" with at least 500 linked articles (the API limit); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The hidden boss and rival achievements have no descriptions; they are placed by API name: ClearBMS ("Scrap Metal", Metal Sonic), ClearBDE ("Sunny side up", read as the Death Egg), ClearBSD ("Shadow Boxing", Shadow), ClearBPC ("Perfect Punisher", Perfect Chaos), ClearBSL ("Silver Got Served", Silver) and ClearBNE ("Boom Boom Dragoon"). Hidden stage feats are placed by their API prefixes (Ssz, Sph, Cte, Ssh, Csc, Euc, Pla); ClearEUC is "ROOFTOP RUN Restored!", so Euc is read as Rooftop Run. "Treasure Hunter" (CompEmerald) and "Supersonic!" (ClearSuperSonic) sit in the last stage chapter as a guess. Grouping three stages per chapter is our own choice.
